title: Cardiac MRI 3D Ejection Fraction Estimation
summary: A project estimating Ejection Fraction from Cardiac MRI images using 3D U-Net and MONAI, structured around a training/evaluation pipeline. It lists sdv, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, and copulas in its requirements.txt, but no code in the evidence calls any of them.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv==0.15.0, ctgan==0.5.1, rdt==0.6.4, sdmetrics==0.5.0, copulas==0.7.0; no matching code usage found
needs: No call sites found for sdv/ctgan/rdt/sdmetrics/copulas; unclear if used for data augmentation of MRI-derived tabular data or left unused.
